description: Deliberately held-out organochlorine pesticide probe set. These CAS numbers are excluded from train/val for both Ames and carcinogenicity models (RF/GBM baseline and GNN) so that generalization to this compound class -- the subject of the original chemRxiv paper's under-prediction finding -- can be tested honestly, rather than relying on a random split to leave them out (which it did not: 6 of the original 7 spot-checked compounds turned out to be in-training data).
source: Curated list of classic organochlorine pesticides, cross-referenced against data/raw/cpdb/carcinogenicity_final.csv by name match, with one false-positive regex match (Riddelliine, a pyrrolizidine alkaloid, not an organochlorine) manually excluded.
